source: Benchmark controls and records are delivered together with this file.
notes: The grasp preview was terminated. Later competing compute jobs were stopped; affected timing runs were rejected and repeated.
Accepted timing runs have no sampled competing CUDA compute process. The desktop CUDA service remained active.
Primary MPM cases interleave capacities and solver variants in random order; XPBD stress predictors are measured serially because captured hash-grid descriptors cannot safely interleave in Warp 1.17.
Reported medians summarize three trial medians, not three independent physical scenes. Quality metrics sample the rollout endpoint.
Contact-history ablations have one trajectory per particle count and preserve temporal particle stress while clearing only contact impulses.
Point contacts and S2 each use their own 100-sweep reference. Errors measure convergence within a discretization, not physical accuracy.
Fast/full timings use the original bowl material defaults; low-iteration tests enable the critical-fraction law and disable early convergence. Compare those tables separately.
Ten-second fast-mode containment probes copy state for diagnostics after timing each frame. Their timing is not the primary latency measurement.
The two-iteration large-particle XPBD case spills over the open rim; its failed endpoint validation is retained. Four iterations or four substeps prevent escape in the ten-second probe.
CR diagnostic failures are retained separately and are not accepted fidelity/performance candidates.
